recipes.name: Cheesy Chicken Bundles
ingredients_raw: 0.5 cup cheese-flavored crackers (such as Cheez-It Duoz Sharp Cheddar and Parmesan®), crushed

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a 9x12-inch baking dish.

Place a chicken breast between two sheets of heavy plastic (resealable freezer bags work well) on a solid, level surface. Firmly pound the chicken breast with the smooth side of a meat mallet to a thickness of 1/4 inch. Repeat with the other chicken breasts.
Melt the butter in a small skillet, and cook the mushrooms until they begin to brown, about 8 minutes. Set aside. Beat egg in a shallow bowl. Place the cracker crumbs in another shallow bowl.

In a bowl, mix together the mushrooms, cream cheese, 1 cup of Cheddar cheese, and Parmesan cheese; spread the mixture generously over the chicken. Roll the chicken breasts up, dip each into beaten egg, and roll the bundles in cracker crumbs. Place into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the bundles with the remaining 1/4 cup of Cheddar cheese.

Bake in the preheated oven until the chicken is cooked through, the filling has melted, and the crumbs are golden brown, about 30 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of a roll should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Cheesy Chicken Bundles
raw_recipe.description: Chicken breasts are rolled around a creamy Cheddar cheese and mushroom filling, then coated in cheesy cracker crumbs and baked until golden brown.

review.reviewBody: this is a wonderful recipe, I spreed mayo on my chicken and then rolled it in the cracker crumbs. Can add any mixture that you like in the filling. I change often to make it a little diferent all the time.

I'm in the middle of eating this recipe and had to leave a review. My boyfriend LOVES it. I used Neufchatel cheese instead of cream cheese just to save on calories and it was still delicious. I used fresh mushrooms and threw in some red onion. Oh..my..goodness. Thank you so much! I'll be making this again!
We Loved it!! I followed the recipe exactly. My husband says he doesn't like mushrooms! I pureed them in the food processer he never noticed!! This was Awesome!

We loved it! We substituted the cheezits with saltine crackers and found this to be great -- a little less cheesy, so it wasn't overwhelming. My husband isn't a big fan of the canned mushrooms we have, but he loved them sauteed in butter and stuffed in the chicken.

This was incredible! I made a few changes the second time I made it. I used half a package of cream cheese--there are only two of us--and used onions and jalapenos instead of mushrooms. It was beyond delicious. I also had to cook it about 45 minutes instead of thirty, but it was still so very juicy and tender.

Definitely different and something to serve for a special occasion. I added garlic to the cheese filling. Made 1/2 with mushrooms and 1/2 without (hubby does not like mushrooms). Did not have cheese flavored crackers so used Panko crumbs with grated parm mixed in. Very rich main coarse, but tasty.

Thought it was great to begin with but made a few changes to suit our tastes. I only used about half the amount of mushrooms but added 1 minced large clove of garlic and about 1/4 of a large onion also minced. I also used the Italian Cheez-its instead of cheddar, parmesan/romano instead of just parmesan and 4 cheese Italian blend shredded cheese instead of chedder. It tasted great and was a BIG hit with my wife.
awesome soo yummy had no plan cream cheese used herb and garlic instead was delish!
What a wonderful recipe! My in-laws gave it rave reviews. I used fresh mushrooms and herb and garlic cream cheese. Yummy! Thanks for a great recipe.

We just made this and it was totally delicious! I'd say even better than a similar M&S chicken type meal. We used philadelphia whipped garlic and herb instead of plain cream cheese and didn't have any mushrooms so just left those out. Mmmmmm!

I thought this was a really great recipe, I doubled it for a dinner party last night and it was a hit. I didnt roll the chicken bundles in the crackers, I just put them over the top of the chicken in the pan, and I put the leftover filling over the top too before adding the rest of the cheese to the top.
Very Good!!! I didnt use the cheese crackers i used panko crumbs chicken came out so good I also used asperagus in the creamcheese mixture this will be a regular in our house

We did not like this. The salt/cheese content is overwhelming. My boyfriend didn't even finish his.... Which is not at all like him to leave any food on his plate. There isn't any freshness about it. I agree with the previous comment, it tastes like you are eating a huge chunk if salty cheese with a piece of chicken rolled in it. I do not recommend this.
I ALWAYS SAUTE MY MUSHROOMS IN BUTTER, DALES, AND VARIOUS SEASONINGS I HAVE ON HAND (EXAMPLES: GARLIC SALT, TONY'S, ITALIAN SEASONING) TO ADD A LITTLE EXTRA FLAVOR

Very bland. Followed recipe exactly. Tastes like you're eating a large chunk of cream cheese, with some sort of meat product wrapped around it. If you like plain chicken breasts and cream cheese, you'll like this recipe...

Loved it! I used a can of cream of mushroom soup instead of mushrooms, since both myself and my husband hate them. We loved it! I only used two chicken breasts but made the full amount of filling, so we had lots. Delicious, and I can't wait to make it again.
I just gave this recipe a try last night, and I wasn't disappointed. Even my boyfriend had seconds, and he's terrified of my cooking! It's an easy recipe and provides a rich and hearty meal.

This was excellent. My whole family just loved it. 
I made the puffed potato casserole with it to. My family totally enjoyed both. I will be making this again.
try a different flavored cream chz....use 3/4 of the block.

Growing up in Wisconsin, I learned to love and to know my cheese. This was really good, but between all the different cheeses (cream cheese esp.), it was a little heavy to eat. I normally just make recipes for something to do, and this one piece of chicken by itself was a full meal for all 190lbs of me. However, because it was so delicious and easy, it gets 5 stars. And I will certainly be making this again soon, probably with a little less cream cheese.
